div.head: Quadr II Praef 10
div.ab: Lex alia naturalis, que apud omnes eadem est, alia constitutionis, in qua habet unaqueque patria suum aliquid proprium uiuendique uernaculum.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 543 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: One law is natural, which is the same among all; another is of enactment, in which each country has something of its own and a native way of living.
